instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium shot captures a sunny park pathway. On the left, the man in the plaid shirt (R1) walks forward, wearing sunglasses and looking toward his companion. On the right, the woman in the dark blue shirt (R2) walks beside him, smiling warmly as she looks back. They walk closely side-by-side under dappled sunlight filtering through green trees, creating a bright, warm atmosphere.
